title: Order Tracking
description: A print-order status page: estimated delivery, labelled progress steps, a dated history and the order details.
summary: Steps for where the order is, a timeline for what happened.
notes: Steps show where the order is now (aria-current="step"); the timeline records what already happened. Both are static: your order system must render the current stage and events.
Timeline dot colours repeat the state already written in each event title, so colour is never the only signal.
The steps row uses .container-query, so labels go inline from a 60rem container and stack below it. Order, printer and address are fictional.
